desc:
👍Like the game! New code at 30K likes

A glimmer is seen coming closer in the distance, its a cat... WITH A KNIFE ! 😼🗡️

💚INNOCENT: Survive and help others in uncovering the murderer!
🛡️SHERIFF: Protect the innocents with your powerful gun!
🗡️MURDERER: Dodge bullets from pesky sheriffs and kill everyone!

✨Play various roles and gamemodes centered around this feline version of the Murder Mystery genre!
👓Customize yourself with plenty of skins and accessories!
😹Express yourself with emotes!
🎖️LVL up and climb the leaderboard!

🎁Make sure to press "NOTIFY" so you never miss out on another daily gift - we send reminder notifications!

Game is in open alpha so expect bugs and unfinished content. Please report all bugs, suggestions, & cheaters in our community server!
